title: Richard Dedekind: Source-Checked Editions and English Translations
version: 2026-06-04 Dedekind GMW Volume I Items I-IV
description:
Dedicated Richard Dedekind author record for source-checked editions and English translations. Current reader surface includes the collected Gesammelte mathematische Werke PDFs, the complete German/English edition of Was sind und was sollen die Zahlen?, the early Stetigkeit und irrationale Zahlen segment, Dedekind/Dirichlet paratext items LII-LIX, and a source-checked German/English cumulative layer for GMW Volume I Items I-IV.

Corrections and contributions. Source comparisons, LaTeX fixes, translation corrections, and reader-facing issue reports can be suggested through the GitHub mirror via issues or pull requests: https://github.com/KokunoYumeto/modern-latex-manuscripts.
notes: Current public surface promotes GMW Volume I Items I-IV. The latest source packet includes the printed pp.27-39 source scan slice; next continuation follows the GMW Volume I Item IV layer.
